name: n8n-workflow-tester-safe
description: Safe MCP server and CLI tool for testing, scoring, and inspecting n8n workflows. Features 19 tools for workflow testing, execution traces, tiered scoring, and a built-in node catalog with 800+ node types. Designed with safety-first approach: no credential management, no secrets lifecycle, no auto-fix loops.
